description: This file contains implementation of test utility functions for the Zephyr ztest framework, including functions for managing test arguments, determining whether test suites or cases should run, and a struct with function pointers for test execution.

methods.name: ztest_relative_filename
methods.description: Returns the input filename; intended to shorten filenames by removing current directory.

methods.name: ztest_reset_test_args
methods.description: Resets the test arguments to NULL.

methods.name: ztest_set_test_args
methods.description: Sets the test arguments to a duplicate of the input string.

methods.name: ztest_get_test_args
methods.description: Returns a duplicate of the current test arguments or NULL.

methods.name: z_ztest_testargs_contains
methods.description: Checks if the test arguments contain the specified suite and test name.

methods.name: z_ztest_should_suite_run
methods.description: Determines if a test suite should run based on command line arguments and predicate.

methods.name: z_ztest_should_test_run
methods.description: Determines if a test case should run based on command line arguments.
